Greetings folks!

A brand new level has been added - The Mill -

[list]

[/list]

Please provide any feedback regarding the general difficulty in the level, if some objects are unobtainable - and feedback to the level in general!

Additional music track added.
Misc minor fixes

Have fun!

notes.title: Playtest 0.3.8 - Train Station Level Added + More
notes.notes:
[p]Welcome to Santa's Train Station! 

For this major update of the Playtest you get to explore the cozy train station and if you manage to safely cross the train tracks, you can explore an inviting pub, where you can find lots of different objects!

This new level in the playtest is 95% complete; there are only a few art related bugs, remaining set dressing and lots more optional items to find.

But the main gameplay loop and all quest items are there for you to find!

So get hunting for all the hidden items you can find! Remember to report any findings (no pun intended) on our Discord!

Have fun :) 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45310658/5cb36d8c022833b17e3cb2fbc4d521e29e5b04ff.png"][/img] [/p]

notes.title: Fantastic Findings - Playtest 0.3.5 - New Camera & Tutorial
notes.notes:
[p]Howdy folks! We are coming in hot this summer with a brand new Camera system & Tutorial to test! We have gotten a lot of great feedback regarding the camera system; being difficult to navigate.

So a more freeform camera has been added, as well as supporting keyboard input as well, using arrow keys or WASD keys to move the camera!

Please let us know on[url="https://discord.gg/824eHhrpps" style="button"] Discord[/url] or [url="https://bsky.app/profile/shapeshift.bsky.social" style="button"]Bluesky[/url] what you think about the latest changes!

Happy hunting! [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45310658/4856e3a4348d05809c20630dcdb16685eb8bdb73.png"][/img][/p]
